sam: Heads-up — canary for dedicated pool eu-west-2-dedicated-42 is showing a large latency regression for long-context models after the latest merge 0b3f7c. p95 went from ~420ms -> ~1.2s and p99 from ~740ms -> ~1.8s. SLA risk for customers on reserved capacity.

deploy-bot: Deployed commit 0b3f7c (merge M#345) to canary pool eu-west-2-dedicated-42 — https://ci.internal/release/0b3f7c :package:

elaine: looking into this now. do we know whether it's kernel-selection or batching-related?

sam: initial diff touches kernel_selector.cpp (priority weights) and batch_controller (max_delay_ms: 8 -> 20). suspect batching window bump increased coalescing and is flushing KV cache more often on long sequences. snippet from canary logs:
```
[2026-03-18T09:12:03Z] kv_cache: hit_rate=0.54 prev=0.92 evictions/sec=18
[2026-03-18T09:12:03Z] batching: batch_size=12 avg_delay_ms=18
```

mike: I reproduced locally with the longseq harness. When the batching window is widened p99 jumps consistently. KV cache hit drops from ~92% to ~54% and evictions spike. looks like kernel ordering triggers slightly different cache reuse patterns too. :thinking:

jana: any CI failures that picked this up?

sam: yes—nightly perf job "dedicated-smoke-longseq" (job 42587) shows ~15% p99 regression after the merge, link: https://ci.internal/jobs/42587/results. Git bisect narrows to merge M#345 -> touches both kernel_selector and batching heuristics.

elaine: propose we revert M#345 in canary immediately and hold rollout. @oncall-bot please pause the dedicated rollout and open a rollback ticket.

oncall-bot: Hold placed on rollout for pool eu-west-2-dedicated-42. Ticket INFRA-2287 created: "Canary p99 spike after M#345 — hold & investigate".

mike: I'll open a revert PR for the batching change and add a targeted test that asserts kv_cache hit_rate >= 0.85 for the longseq workload. will also add a perf gate in CI: if nightly p99 regresses >7% fail the merge.

sam: plan: revert in canary, run canary-health check (x10), validate kv_hit and p99, then re-evaluate kernel-selector tweaks separately with microbenchmarks. i'll update INFRA-2287 with results. thanks all. :thumbsup:
